items.question: What is a people operations system?
items.answer: A people operations system runs the day-to-day plumbing of an employer — employee records, time off and attendance, contracts and documents, performance reviews, and the reporting that flows out to payroll and finance.

items.question: How is Taito.ai different from an HRIS?
items.answer: A traditional HRIS is a digital filing cabinet — it stores employee records, generates contracts, and tracks time off, but every workflow still needs a person to push it forward.

items.question: How much does Taito.ai cost?
items.answer: €10 per seat per month on monthly billing, €8 per seat per month on annual billing. One tier. Everything inside.
